summary: Iteration 184 - Updated CRED-style Login Flow Tests - ALL PASSED. New flow: Users WITH MPIN go directly to MPIN screen (no OTP). 'Forgot MPIN?' triggers OTP → new MPIN setup. Backend APIs (/auth/check-user, /auth/mpin-direct-login, /auth/forgot-mpin, /auth/reset-mpin) all working correctly. Frontend Login.js shows correct step-based flow with proper UI elements.
critical_code_review_comments: New /auth/check-user endpoint correctly returns user_exists, has_mpin, firstName without sending OTP
New /auth/mpin-direct-login takes {email, mpin} and returns session directly - no temp_token needed
New /auth/forgot-mpin sends OTP to email for MPIN reset with 30s rate limit
New /auth/reset-mpin verifies OTP and sets new MPIN, then logs user in
Existing /auth/start still works for users without MPIN
MPIN validation: must be exactly 4 digits
Rate limiting: 30s cooldown between OTP requests
Frontend correctly routes: email → check-user → (has_mpin? → MPIN screen / no_mpin? → OTP → setup)
MPIN screen shows 'Hi, {firstName}' greeting and 'Forgot MPIN?' link
